verbatim: Soulbound and vow-gated; the blade rejects any wielder who has not signed a vow to it, and breaking that vow triggers a Pressure Inversion Rupture localized to the forearm nodes, a Crystal Fracture Event confined to one limb. Each triggered Severance Pulse costs an estimated 40 to 60 EU drawn from the wielder alongside the blood-Essence it drinks; more than roughly five triggers in one engagement pushes toward Lattice Burnout and an uncontrolled Cascade Overrun that can shred nearby allies' own Resonance. Going more than a lunar cycle without blood contact induces Harmonic Mute, leaving the blade fully inert until fed again.

context_lines.verbatim: Mass approximately 1.1 kg; overall length approximately 115 cm, of which the blade is approximately 95 cm; point of balance approximately 6 cm from the guard, close in hand as an estoc's thrusting geometry demands (all estimates; the card gives no figures). Soul Affinity runs highest with Bluvest lineages, Dhampir and High Vampire, and secondarily with Reactive-Path bodies across Stage VII, Refraction, through Stage VIII, Transcendence, putting a bonded wielder's output in the A to S Grade range. At that output the blade reliably beats proofed plate from Hollow through A-Grade; against SS-Grade and heavier Domain-scale wards, it fails to land cleanly.

**Severance Pulse.** Drinking Essence carried in fresh blood on a hit lets the *Uur* (Disruption) glyph condition a Mortalis boundary against the target's own Aether Shell lattice, fracturing it on the following hit; overcharged, the same boundary escalates from Resonance Fracture into full Vector Severance, unthreading the lattice rather than merely cracking it.

verbatim: Not soulbound to any one bearer; it is held under a threefold vow and Black Concord custody rather than a personal bond. Breaking any clause of the vow triggers a Pressure Reversal that folds the wielder's own Essence inward, a self-directed Crystal Fracture Event. Each Event-Edge strike costs an estimated 80 to 120 EU, consistent with the higher draw Limina Void-class workings carry as a Family. context_lines.verbatim: The blade proper reads no mass on any instrument, a documented property of Limina Void-class condensations rather than an oversight; the hilt-and-ring shell alone masses approximately 0.5 kg. It does not beat armour by Strike Force at all: Topology Collapse unthreads whatever it touches regardless of proofed Grade, so no plate, however heavily proofed, offers a defence against contact. It fails only against a Class V Radiant Aether Shell or an active, stabilized Domain ward, either of which can resist or dissipate the collapse before it completes.

page_title: Upanga wa Misimu Minne · Blade of the Four Seasons
label: Cycle Severance.
file: wiki/Artifacts/Upanga wa Misimu Minne · Blade of the Four Seasons.md
verbatim: **Cycle Severance.** A four-day rite, one attunement per season-day. Bill of goods: the blade itself, an unbroken four-day presence at the corrupted site, and the pommel's seed-gem as a holding vessel. Order of operations: the Spring cut opens the land's Essence pathways; the Summer strike burns out corrupted residue along them; the Autumn draw pulls the loosened corruption into the seed-gem; the Winter cut locks the purified pattern in place. Breaking the sequence anywhere leaves the land half-purified and structurally unstable, a standing Threshold Event risk to any Essence current nearby. Estimated cost: roughly 600 EU per day, approximately 2,400 EU across the full rite, an estimate within Chimwala's Stage VIII, Band B range.

context_lines.verbatim: Tier Grade is the qualitative bracket that determines what scale of force, phenomenon, or entity a practitioner can meaningfully engage, resist, or overcome. It is derived from a Sub-Stat's raw numeric value and confirmed by Temperance Stage. A stat cannot hold its Tier Grade if the Soul Crystal has not undergone the Threshold required to sustain that density.

At **Zenith, Stage XIV**, speed and attack output are no longer assessed by conventional metrics. The character exists in a state where the Continuum's ordinary measuring systems require metaphysical recalibration to even register the practitioner's presence. Zenith characters do not move faster than light. They exist within frameworks where the question of movement speed has ceased to be the relevant variable.

Temperance Stage functions as a hard ceiling on every Sub-Stat in the system, and a Primary's mean therefore cannot exceed it either. A character cannot allocate their way past a ceiling their Soul Crystal cannot structurally sustain. Throne alone carries no ceiling. The Crystal must have undergone the corresponding Threshold Event before it can hold a stat at the grade above.
| Stage | Name | Max Grade | Sub-Stat ceiling | Tier of Standing |
Stage XIII is the First World Spirit threshold. Stage XIV is Full World Spirit, the furthest reach of canonical mortal coherence. Stage XV is Archon-participant territory.

> **The Tier of Standing column is the Accord's public ladder**, not a second measurement. It replaces the former lettered Coherence Bands, which shared their letters with the Grade table and stopped at Zenith. The nine Tiers reach Revelation and Apex. Efficiency (η) still runs underneath them as the diagnostic axis, and two practitioners at the same Tier with different η are the same rank and not the same problem. Full treatment in **The Standing and the Title — The Three Names**.

**Dissonance, Stage XI, carries unique behavior.** Characters who pass through Dissonance rather than becoming trapped within it reach Stage XII with stats that are fractured but denser than the clean advancement path would produce. Certain Sub-Stats, particularly **Overflow, Overchannel and Persistence**, can only reach their true ceiling in a character who has passed through Dissonance. The fractures are not damage. They are architectural features. Emanation, Stage XII, is where those fractures become features that radiate outward.

**Zenith, Stage XIV:** Immeasurable Speed classification applies at full expression. The practitioner does not move through space. In the limit case, they exist in all relevant positions simultaneously until they choose otherwise.

Durability is the total destructive energy a character can absorb, deflect, distribute or endure without structural failure of body, Aether Shell or Soul Crystal. It is a composite of four layered systems.

**Layer Two: Aether Shell Shielding.** The active Essence field surrounding every practitioner above F-Grade, buffering between incoming force and the body. Density governed by Resilience, particularly Integrity, Hardening and Fortification. The Shell absorbs and redistributes incoming energy across its entire surface before residual force reaches the body. A Shell rated at 5 TJ absorbs 5 TJ across all concurrent attacks before anything reaches flesh.

**Below Refraction the anchor is not the body.** A working below Stage VII needs voice, hand, ink or blood, and anchor reach is measured from the anchor rather than from the man. This is the whole commercial case for a drawn circle and an inscribed wall. They move the origin to where the boundary is needed, and a good one is worth more than a Grade.

Aura Pressure is the passive force a character's metaphysical presence exerts on everything in proximity. Not a technique. Not activated or deactivated. The ambient consequence of a Soul Crystal existing at a given density within a given Temperance Stage. It increases monotonically with Tier Grade and Temperance advancement and cannot be reduced below baseline without active suppression.

At **A-Grade and above** it becomes a genuine combat factor. An A-Grade character standing within ten meters of an F-Grade practitioner exerts gravitational-analogue pressure equivalent to several hundred kilograms of distributed weight. The F-Grade practitioner's knees bend. Their breathing compresses. Their Aether Shell begins consuming Essence to resist the ambient load. At **S-Grade**, B-Grade and below characters inside the field take passive structural damage to their Shell simply by being present. At **SS-Grade** the effects become geological. Stone cracks. Water compresses. Air becomes optically dense. Footsteps leave indentations not from body mass but because Aura pressure exceeds the soil's load-bearing capacity.

**Body Path.** Direct multiplicative bonus to Strike Force, Durability and Lifting Strength, from **+5%** at early Temperance Stages to **+20%** at Stage XII and above. The shortest road and the most immediately reliable. Body Path practitioners at equivalent Grade and Stage consistently out-hit, out-tank and out-lift their counterparts by margins that widen with advancement. Trade-off: reduced bonuses to Range and Aura Pressure, so they must close distance to leverage the advantage.

**Essence-Typed Damage.** Force delivered through Wellspring-attuned technique carries that Wellspring's signature. Pyreveil adds thermal energy. Fractura adds structural destabilization. Vohrin adds thermal extraction. These are not counted in the Strike Force benchmark because they are Wellspring-dependent, but they represent real additional damage that can push effective yield above the raw Joule rating. A Fractura-enhanced strike targeting a pre-identified fault line in the target's Aether Shell can produce Shell failure at yields **thirty to fifty percent below** the Shell's rated ceiling, because the strike is applying force at the exact frequency and vector that maximizes structural degradation.

context_lines.verbatim: | Zenith | Stage XIV | Unquantified | Unquantified | — | Continuum recalibration required |

Durability is the total destructive energy a character can absorb, deflect, distribute or endure without structural failure of body, Aether Shell or Soul Crystal. It is a composite of four layered systems.

**Layer Two: Aether Shell Shielding.** The active Essence field surrounding every practitioner above F-Grade, buffering between incoming force and the body. Density governed by Resilience, particularly Integrity, Hardening and Fortification. The Shell absorbs and redistributes incoming energy across its entire surface before residual force reaches the body. A Shell rated at 5 TJ absorbs 5 TJ across all concurrent attacks before anything reaches flesh.

**Below Refraction the anchor is not the body.** A working below Stage VII needs voice, hand, ink or blood, and anchor reach is measured from the anchor rather than from the man. This is the whole commercial case for a drawn circle and an inscribed wall. They move the origin to where the boundary is needed, and a good one is worth more than a Grade.

Aura Pressure is the passive force a character's metaphysical presence exerts on everything in proximity. Not a technique. Not activated or deactivated. The ambient consequence of a Soul Crystal existing at a given density within a given Temperance Stage. It increases monotonically with Tier Grade and Temperance advancement and cannot be reduced below baseline without active suppression.

At **A-Grade and above** it becomes a genuine combat factor. An A-Grade character standing within ten meters of an F-Grade practitioner exerts gravitational-analogue pressure equivalent to several hundred kilograms of distributed weight. The F-Grade practitioner's knees bend. Their breathing compresses. Their Aether Shell begins consuming Essence to resist the ambient load. At **S-Grade**, B-Grade and below characters inside the field take passive structural damage to their Shell simply by being present. At **SS-Grade** the effects become geological. Stone cracks. Water compresses. Air becomes optically dense. Footsteps leave indentations not from body mass but because Aura pressure exceeds the soil's load-bearing capacity.

**Body Path.** Direct multiplicative bonus to Strike Force, Durability and Lifting Strength, from **+5%** at early Temperance Stages to **+20%** at Stage XII and above. The shortest road and the most immediately reliable. Body Path practitioners at equivalent Grade and Stage consistently out-hit, out-tank and out-lift their counterparts by margins that widen with advancement. Trade-off: reduced bonuses to Range and Aura Pressure, so they must close distance to leverage the advantage.

**Essence-Typed Damage.** Force delivered through Wellspring-attuned technique carries that Wellspring's signature. Pyreveil adds thermal energy. Fractura adds structural destabilization. Vohrin adds thermal extraction. These are not counted in the Strike Force benchmark because they are Wellspring-dependent, but they represent real additional damage that can push effective yield above the raw Joule rating. A Fractura-enhanced strike targeting a pre-identified fault line in the target's Aether Shell can produce Shell failure at yields **thirty to fifty percent below** the Shell's rated ceiling, because the strike is applying force at the exact frequency and vector that maximizes structural degradation.

Water compresses. Air becomes optically dense. Footsteps leave indentations not from body mass but because Aura pressure exceeds the soil's load-bearing capacity.

**Layer Two: Aether Shell Shielding.** The active Essence field surrounding every practitioner above F-Grade, buffering between incoming force and the body. Density governed by Resilience, particularly Integrity, Hardening and Fortification. The Shell absorbs and redistributes incoming energy across its entire surface before residual force reaches the body. A Shell rated at 5 TJ absorbs 5 TJ across all concurrent attacks before anything reaches flesh.

**Below Refraction the anchor is not the body.** A working below Stage VII needs voice, hand, ink or blood, and anchor reach is measured from the anchor rather than from the man. A ladder with Grade-sensitive modifiers reads the Sub-Stat; a ladder that only needs the tier reads Master either way. verbatim: AU/s is a **ceiling on the rate**, not a duty cycle. No practitioner runs at their AU/s continuously, and sustained work runs at a fraction of it. The small practitioner's broadcast suppression costs 390 EU, is a full-broadcast sympathetic suppression across twenty-five feet, and lasts eight seconds: 390 ÷ 8 = 48.75 AU/s, one tenth of the ceiling. The ceiling is what the practitioner can do for a heartbeat; the tenth is what they do for eight seconds. **Read a practitioner's AU/s as the number that caps a burst, and read a working's EU ÷ duration as the number that runs a scene.**

# VII. Aether Class, Essence Typology, Aether Flow (Parts Seventeen–Nineteen)
### Part Seventeen — The Aether Class System
#### What Aether Class Measures

Temperance measures refinement of the Essence Core on the Soul Plane. Tier Grade measures raw output magnitude. **Aether Class measures one thing only: how cleanly the Aether Shell conducts Essence outward into form.** It is the Shell's transparency. When the Essence Core speaks, how much of what it says actually arrives?

Two characters at identical stat values and Temperance Stage can have wildly different combat output if one is Class III Resonant and the other Class I Muridic. The stats are the same. The delivery is not.
#### The Seven Aether Classes

**Class I — The Muridic.** The awakening Shell, flickering with first resonance. Essence leaks unevenly into space. Emotion distorts weather and mood. Will echoes unpredictably. The bearer may appear unstable when their lattice is simply learning to speak. Glory, Stage VI, Harmonic Crystal, where Aether Class first emerges; **Stages I through V are unclassed, and the coil reads no Class.** **Roughly thirty to forty percent efficiency loss** to Shell interference.

page_title: VII. Aether Class, Essence Typology, Aether Flow (Parts Seventeen–Nineteen)
label: One EU is one megajoule.
file: wiki/Fracture of Worlds — The Living System/VII. Aether Class, Essence Typology, Aether Flow (Parts Seventeen–Nineteen).md
verbatim: **One EU is one megajoule.** One AU is one EU, so **1 AU/s is 1 MW**. Power drawn is AU/s × 1 MW, power delivered is AU/s × η × 1 MW, and the difference leaves as heat, sound and structural bleed. A reserve of *E* EU spent at *R* AU/s empties in *E* ÷ *R* seconds, and that figure does not depend on the conversion at all.

context_lines.verbatim: **A Commission Tier is not a Grade.** A Threat Tier names the practitioner rank a Commission requires: T4 means the Accord sends Adepts, T7 means it sends Grandmasters under a Gold Sigil and nobody engages lawfully without one. A Grade is a joule band. A Tier of Standing is a set of Grades. So the Commission's T is a figure for the answer, and the Ledger's rung is a figure for the thing, and **the Ledger's standing, output plus modifiers, is the Ledger's figure for the same question the Commission asks.** Where the Commission weighs the same three things the Ledger weighs, the two agree, and across most of the register they do.

| **Lich** | T9 | the necromancer's own Grade | R, P, W | **its Tier of Standing + 3** | Legions, the phylactery, and Wellspring flows bent to its will. It stands at nine only if the person stood at six |
| **Mnemonis Solution** | not entered | — | 100 – 500 EU in fifty millilitres, sized to a Stage V reserve of 1,600 EU | Draught | none | **Draught** |
| **Refraction Draught** | T6 | IV / A / 50 | 10⁵ – 10⁶ EU: the dual-sight transition at Stage VII | Elixir | Carry Marked: the donor's way of seeing recorded, no move | **Elixir** |
| **Soulbound** | Answers one soul and refuses the rest | **Never above the bearer's Tier of Standing**, because every act crosses the bearer's Shell. In any other hand it has no rung |

| **The Ocular Codex of Thirteen Mouths** | stored: what it has drunk and been fed | up to 4.2 × 10⁶: whole workings below Stage VII, A-Grade and under | up to 4.184 × 10¹² J | Free: whoever last fed it | **Relic** | the store; the rung travels with the book |

**Whose η.** The crossing is the summoner's Shell, so the summoner's own η is read wherever it is recorded. Where it is not, the crossing is read at the summon's own Aether Class, because Aether Class governs how much of the donated Essence survives the crossing into form: Class I loses thirty to forty percent (η 0.60–0.70), Class II fifteen to twenty-five (η 0.75–0.85), Class III five to ten (η 0.90–0.95), and Class V delivers one hundred percent or more (η 1.00 and above). **A call cost given as a share of reserve is as large as the summoner's reserve makes it**, and where the reserve is not recorded it is set by the law of reserves at the summoner's Level.

| **Faisal's Choir**, one eidolon | a Stage VIII Master | 265,300 EU | 0.92, the summoner's | 2.44 × 10¹¹ J, A | **Ravager** | not rated | sustain 53,050 EU/s against a 2,850,000 EU reserve: empty in 54 s, Starvation in 48 |

context_lines.verbatim: **A Commission Tier is not a Grade.** A Threat Tier names the practitioner rank a Commission requires: T4 means the Accord sends Adepts, T7 means it sends Grandmasters under a Gold Sigil and nobody engages lawfully without one. A Grade is a joule band. A Tier of Standing is a set of Grades. So the Commission's T is a figure for the answer, and the Ledger's rung is a figure for the thing, and **the Ledger's standing, output plus modifiers, is the Ledger's figure for the same question the Commission asks.** Where the Commission weighs the same three things the Ledger weighs, the two agree, and across most of the register they do.

| **Lich** | T9 | the necromancer's own Grade | R, P, W | **its Tier of Standing + 3** | Legions, the phylactery, and Wellspring flows bent to its will. It stands at nine only if the person stood at six |
| **Mnemonis Solution** | not entered | — | 100 – 500 EU in fifty millilitres, sized to a Stage V reserve of 1,600 EU | Draught | none | **Draught** |
| **Refraction Draught** | T6 | IV / A / 50 | 10⁵ – 10⁶ EU: the dual-sight transition at Stage VII | Elixir | Carry Marked: the donor's way of seeing recorded, no move | **Elixir** |
| **Soulbound** | Answers one soul and refuses the rest | **Never above the bearer's Tier of Standing**, because every act crosses the bearer's Shell. In any other hand it has no rung |

| **The Ocular Codex of Thirteen Mouths** | stored: what it has drunk and been fed | up to 4.2 × 10⁶: whole workings below Stage VII, A-Grade and under | up to 4.184 × 10¹² J | Free: whoever last fed it | **Relic** | the store; the rung travels with the book |

**Whose η.** The crossing is the summoner's Shell, so the summoner's own η is read wherever it is recorded. Where it is not, the crossing is read at the summon's own Aether Class, because Aether Class governs how much of the donated Essence survives the crossing into form: Class I loses thirty to forty percent (η 0.60–0.70), Class II fifteen to twenty-five (η 0.75–0.85), Class III five to ten (η 0.90–0.95), and Class V delivers one hundred percent or more (η 1.00 and above). **A call cost given as a share of reserve is as large as the summoner's reserve makes it**, and where the reserve is not recorded it is set by the law of reserves at the summoner's Level.

| **Faisal's Choir**, one eidolon | a Stage VIII Master | 265,300 EU | 0.92, the summoner's | 2.44 × 10¹¹ J, A | **Ravager** | not rated | sustain 53,050 EU/s against a 2,850,000 EU reserve: empty in 54 s, Starvation in 48 |

label: Recorded by reach, not placed.
file: wiki/Fracture of Worlds — The Living System/X. The Tier Ladders (Part Twenty-Four).md
verbatim: **Recorded by reach, not placed.** These Domains carry a radius and no draw the ladder can read: the Open Crucible, 40 m and past active maintenance; the Adamant Forge, anchored to the Forge complex; the Sounding, fifty kilometres at η 0.89; the Forge of Endurance, 3.2 km and 8 km in Overdrive; the Verdict Domain, a fifty-kilometre law field; the Ember Sanctum, thirty kilometres of pressure radius around a smaller Realm; an influence of one to two kilometres under full Emanation; a Domain-Precursor at up to three kilometres; two Domains of sixty and fifty metres; the Settled Domain of ten; the Waiting Room of about twenty; a seed extended to 120 metres through the Crook of Turned Seasons; the Garden of Still Snow at twelve, the Cinder Court at thirty-five, the Origin Court at eight; the Null, whose radius is environmental; and the Hall of Shattered Mirrors, the Quiet Hour and the Kōkan Totality Domain, which carry no figure at all. **Each has a rung, and the rung waits on its draw.**

Five Bands yield **fifteen thousand** stat points. Thresholds through Stage XIII add roughly **nine thousand one hundred more.** *A full lifetime pool sits near twenty-four thousand one hundred, spread across twenty stats.*

> **Divide that honestly.** A Band II practitioner at Level 156 with Thresholds through Stage V holds about four thousand five hundred points — **two hundred and twenty-five per stat if spread evenly, solidly mid B-Grade, and entirely unremarkable.**

**EU figures ruled.** Call cost is given as 9% of reserve, and the absolute number now stands behind it. Ruled 2026-09-12: Kwon Hae-ryu's EU Reserve is 90,000,000 EU, at Level 355, Stage X Realization, Band IV, and the Call Cost at 9% is approximately 8,100,000 EU. The figure is a log-linear interpolation on Level between the project's fixed anchors, Ara Min at Level 250, roughly 4,200,000, and Borin Ironheart at Level 378, 180,000,000 estimated, and the Borin-to-Mu-jin slope, 850,000,000 at Level 430, confirms it. `Fracture_of_Worlds.pdf` establishes that EU scales with Temperance Stage and is governed by Tempering Yield and gives no Band-by-Band reserve table, so the interpolation is the method and not a source. Borin's figure keeps its estimate marking and Raga's entry, which says only that a Stage X summoner spends most of what he has, stays a loose neighbour; neither is contradicted by this reserve.

label: The reference gun.
file: wiki/The Apparatus of the Age — Equipment and Material Culture/Shot and the Enhanced Weapon.md
verbatim: **The reference gun.** A period revolver in .44, unenhanced: no Essence in the gun, the round or the shooter's working. A lead ball of about 16 g leaves the muzzle at about 235 m/s carrying about 440 J, and crosses ten metres in about 43 ms. That is E-Grade output. A D-Grade practitioner's own strike carries far more. **The gun is not dangerous because it is strong. It is dangerous because it is fast, cheap and needs no reserve.**

wiki/The Apparatus of the Age — Equipment and Material Culture/The Item Tiers.md
verbatim: Costs are drawn from the maker's reserve (1 EU = 1 MJ):

context_lines.verbatim: **An item carries an item Tier, Plain through Proscribed: the lower of what its material can hold and the Tier of Standing its maker stood at when it was made.** A Journeyman's blade is at most Tempered, holding a C-Grade working and no more. A master cannot put an A-Grade working into Greystone: the stone fails first.

**Material tier n holds a working up to item Tier n, level with Tier of Standing n.** Each Tier is the word stamped on the Accord's mark, in Accord Latin beside the old *Probatum est*, and said in plain English at the table and the counter.

**A practitioner can equip themselves but cannot equip an army.** An Apprentice maker (Stage II, reserve about 0.56 EU) can prepare about ninety enhanced rounds from a full reserve before Essence Starvation, or nine enchanted blades, or three suits of proofed armour, or one relic.

label: Bone Growth Kotsuzou
file: wiki/The Disciplines/Recarvu — The Body That Builds Over What It Cannot Fix.md
verbatim: | **Bone Growth** *Kotsuzou* | New bone grows outward from a terminus or fracture site. Extends beyond original length, produces spurs, spines and ridges through the skin, or bridges a fracture gap. **Follows directed intent rather than the body's blueprint** | 3,000–8,000 EU. **Significant pain during growth** as periosteal nerves fire continuously | New bone beyond original geometry has **no tendons to articulate it.** A spur extending six inches from the forearm is a fixed projection, not a limb |

label: Fire Resistance Taika Hifuku
file: wiki/The Disciplines/Recarvu — The Body That Builds Over What It Cannot Fix.md
verbatim: | **Fire Resistance** *Taika Hifuku* | The mineralised outer layer acts as a thermal insulator by the mechanism that makes ceramic tile a heat shield. **It chars rather than burns, and the charring insulates what is beneath** | Requires active Hardening. 3,000–6,000 EU for full coverage | Radiant and conductive heat only. **No protection against convective transfer through airways or Caloria-family techniques that heat the body from within** |

page_title: Rusashin — The Dust That Remembers What It Touched
label: II · Vessel Utsuwa
file: wiki/The Disciplines/Rusashin — The Dust That Remembers What It Touched.md
verbatim: | **II · Vessel** *Utsuwa* | Stage IV | Particles shaped into coherent forms: a gauntlet of compressed pebbles, a cage of interlocking grit, a dragon-fist shell extending the forearm's striking surface. **The shape is held through continuous refresh rather than structural permanence**, new grains replacing dissolving ones. *Sounds like gravel settling. On launch the shape holds 1–2 seconds before fragmenting into shrapnel* | 2,000–4,000 EU. Hand tremor from sustained nucleation vibration |

context_lines.verbatim: | **I · Dust** *Satsujin no Chiri* | Stage III | Essence into loose particulate — dust, pebbles, grit, each a separate 2–3 second nucleation. Launched as low-velocity projectiles or detonated on contact via Fractura fault-seeding. Some grains **draw a thin whip of the target's own Aether back along the fault line**, minor and inconsistent at this Form. *Grey-brown grit, faint mineral smell. On detonation: sharp crack, stone-dust cloud, a pale thread snapping back toward the caster* | 800–1,200 EU per handful |

| **II · Vessel** *Utsuwa* | Stage IV | Particles shaped into coherent forms: a gauntlet of compressed pebbles, a cage of interlocking grit, a dragon-fist shell extending the forearm's striking surface. **The shape is held through continuous refresh rather than structural permanence**, new grains replacing dissolving ones. *Sounds like gravel settling. On launch the shape holds 1–2 seconds before fragmenting into shrapnel* | 2,000–4,000 EU. Hand tremor from sustained nucleation vibration |

| **IV · Trailing** *Rusashin no Kiseki* | Stage VI | A cloud of loose dust pulled together behind a moving object and compressed into hailstone-dense aggregate. **Coagulatio run in reverse order** — solution nucleated from scattered solid, then re-nucleated denser. Each pass increases density; a pebble becomes a stone becomes a ball carrying the accumulated momentum of every grain in it. *Audible grinding compression. Impact sounds like a hammer on stone* | 3,000–6,000 EU per ball. Forearm and shoulder fatigue |

| **V · Shield** *Rusashin no Tate* | Stage VI–VII | **First Fixatio integration.** Load-bearing structures: walls, barriers, hemispherical shields, shaped cannon-rounds, persisting 10–30 seconds beyond the grain lifespan. Petralon activates — the wall bears force the way an arch bears weight, strongest under compression. *On shield-break the wall does not crumble.* *It detonates along pre-seeded fault lines* | 8,000–15,000 EU per wall; 5,000–8,000 per round. Full-body fatigue from sustained curing |

| **VI · Weapon** *Rusashin no Ken* | Stage VII | **Corporis integration threshold** — prior Forms manipulated matter external to the body; Form VI fuses matter to it. User-specific weapons and knuckle-plates that coat the hands in compressed aggregate. **Each weapon is shaped by the practitioner's own combat architecture**, because the nucleation pattern follows their trained movement vocabulary. *Impact sounds ceramic: a sharp, high crack* | 1,500–3,000 EU per weapon. Joint strain from striking with fused mass |

| **VII · Mines** *Rusashin no Oshi* | Stage VII–VIII | Particles held stagnant — suspended in air, embedded in surfaces, floating at calculated distances, **cured in place by Fixatio so they do not dissolve. They wait.** Any or all can be triggered simultaneously from any angle of the body. *Opponents who enter the field discover, too late, that every surface they touched and every volume of air they moved through was seeded* | 6,000–12,000 EU to seed; 200–400 per trigger. Gnosis strain from tracking all dormant charges |

| **VIII · Armour** *Rusashin no Yoroi* | Stage VIII–IX | Particles drawn inward by the practitioner's own Shell suction, cured to the Shell's outer surface, then re-extruded as a carapace that **moves with the body because it is bonded to the body's metaphysical surface rather than its physical one.** Rating is a function of compression cycles run before curing — hasty is ceramic plate, careful approaches forged alloy. **Can be shed explosively as omni-directional shrapnel** | 20,000–40,000 EU to form; 2,000–4,000 EU/s. Restricted mobility until segmented; elevated body temperature |

| **IX · The Dragon** *Russa* | Stage IX–X | A semi-autonomous construct of thousands of interlocking grains. **It is not alive. It is a sculpture that moves because every grain carries a fragment of the practitioner's Coagulatio intent.** Reforms from ambient Rusashin when damaged. Its striking force is the cumulative output of every grain along a single vector. *On impact it does not strike and withdraw.* *It detonates on contact**, every grain in the impact zone triggering its fault simultaneously* | 60,000–120,000 EU. **Single use at Form IX.** Full-body tremor; risk of uncontrolled nucleation if concentration breaks during formation |

Impact sounds like a hammer on stone* | 3,000–6,000 EU per ball. Forearm and shoulder fatigue |

Full-body fatigue from sustained curing |

| **VI · Weapon** *Rusashin no Ken* | Stage VII | **Corporis integration threshold** — prior Forms manipulated matter external to the body; Form VI fuses matter to it. Joint strain from striking with fused mass |

Gnosis strain from tracking all dormant charges |

Restricted mobility until segmented; elevated body temperature |

| **IX · The Dragon** *Russa* | Stage IX–X | A semi-autonomous construct of thousands of interlocking grains. **It is not alive. It is a sculpture that moves because every grain carries a fragment of the practitioner's Coagulatio intent.** Reforms from ambient Rusashin when damaged. Its striking force is the cumulative output of every grain along a single vector. *On impact it does not strike and withdraw.* *It detonates on contact**, every grain in the impact zone triggering its fault simultaneously* | 60,000–120,000 EU. **Single use at Form IX.** Full-body tremor; risk of uncontrolled nucleation if concentration breaks during formation |

label: rated Flux Density
verbatim: **Banked Essence** · A working that takes an incoming load and holds it puts the load in the absorber's own Crystal, not in the room. The bank is bounded by the **rated Flux Density** rather than by the reserve, because a store held at a pressure fails at a pressure. The surplus above rating leaks at the Crystal's own bleed fraction, one minus η of itself per second. A bank therefore lives about three seconds at an η of 0.70 and about twenty at 0.95. The clock is the real limit. **A bank is tempo, not storage.** The leak leaves as heat, sound and structural bleed, so a man holding one is lit up for exactly as long as he holds it.

label: Efficiency · Eta · η

It is not a reserve returning more than it held, and it is not an error on the sheet.

context_lines.verbatim: title: "Tier Grade, Bands & the Aether Shell"
# Tier Grade, Bands & the Aether Shell

> Three separate measurements, constantly confused for one another. **Level** counts how many times a Crystal has densified. **Tier Grade** reports raw magnitude. **Aether Class** reports how much of that magnitude survives the trip out through the Shell. A practitioner is described by all three and by the gaps between them.

The ceiling is **500** for every practitioner below Stage XV. This is the structural limit of what a mortal Soul Crystal can contain before the distinction between practitioner and Principle collapses entirely. Characters below Stage XV who reach Level 500 and continue to accumulate pressure do not advance in level. They begin the Apotheosis approach, a qualitative event outside the scope of numbered progression. **Paragons exceed Level 500.** At Stages XV–XVI, Level keeps rising past 500 with no ceiling and no sixth Band; the Codex does not number it.
| **I · Mortal Foundation** | 1 – 100 | Stage I through IV · Murmuring to Flourishing | Stage IV before Level 100 can be surpassed |
| **II · Awakened** | 101 – 200 | Stage V through VII · Splintering to Refraction | Stage VII before Level 200 can be surpassed |
| **III · Sovereign** | 201 – 300 | Stage VIII through X · Transcendence to Realization | Stage X before Level 300 can be surpassed |
| **IV · Mythic** | 301 – 400 | Stage XI through XII · Dissonance to Emanation | Stage XII before Level 400 can be surpassed |

label: Efficiency (η)
file: wiki/Volume I — Character Cards/Borin Ironheart · The Master of the Soul Forge.md
verbatim: **Efficiency (η):** 0.91 (estimate — exceptionally high for a Body Path practitioner; centuries of forge-discipline have burned away every wasted motion in his Essence routing)

context.aether_class: IV — Luminous (estimate; his output style is sustained and dense ra

context_lines.verbatim: **Catalyst Event (Stage XII — Emanation):** Borin attempted to reforge the Soul Crystal of his former apprentice Thurgan Ashmantle, who had suffered catastrophic Materia corruption — Petrification Compulsion in its terminal expression, the flesh mineralizing from the extremities inward. Thurgan’s Crystal still held structure. Borin was certain the Forge could save him. It could not. Thurgan’s remaining consciousness chose dissolution over reconstruction, and Borin had to hold the quench steady while the Forge consumed his apprentice rather than saved him. The Dissonance was the collision between Borin’s fundamental principle — permanence, endurance, things made to last — and the universe’s answer that some things reach a state where lasting is the cruelty. He emerged understanding that permanence is a gift offered, not a sentence imposed. The fractures in his Crystal are the places where he stopped insisting.
**Temperance Stage:** XII — Emanation, active. Universal ceiling: 950, max Grade SSS, Tier of Standing 7, Grandmaster.
**Tier of Standing:** 7, Grandmaster
**Aether Class:** IV — Luminous (estimate; his output style is sustained and dense rather than explosive, producing readings that feel heavier than the class number suggests)

*All values are estimates pending formal stat sheet verification against Fracture_of_Worlds.pdf. At Level 378, Stage XII Emanation, the point economy yields approximately 18,000 total allocation points. Borin is a specialist craftsman, not a combat architecture — his peaks cluster in diagnostic, endurance, and Domain stats; his valleys are in speed and burst output.*
| Dominion | ~810 | SSS | The Soul Forge Domain. Stage XII Emanation’s passive environmental effect — metal behaves differently near him. |
**Domain Stage:** Stabilized, radiating (Stage XII Emanation — passive environmental effects without deliberate activation)

He wears layered blue robes patterned with diamond-geometric textile work — High Dwarf Rite of Bound Geometry tradition expressed in cloth, each diamond a functioning micro-inscription too small to read without Judicium-grade perception. Gold and bronze leather harness system across the chest and waist, bearing tool pouches, tong-loops, and suspension points for implements too heavy for a belt. Left pauldron of ornate metalwork with green stone inlays in runic geometric pattern — his workshop insignia, a piece he forged for himself at Stage X and never replaced because it has not needed replacing. Fur-lined shoulder piece on the right, practical against the temperature differential between forge-face and tunnel-draft. Heavy boots, dark leather with metal toe-caps and geometric stitching, the soles worn into the exact contour of the Forge’s stone floor.
